name: Hunan Hualian China Industry Co., Ltd.
summary: Established in 1994 and based in Zhuzhou City, China, Hunan Hualian China Industry Co., Ltd. is primarily engaged in the comprehensive process of ceramic product development, including design, research, manufacturing, and distribution within China. Its offerings span various categories, featuring household ceramics such as tableware, tea sets, mugs, seasoning jars, and cups, marketed under brand names like siv·Heike, LOTOTO, Jianlin, and Porcelain Soul. Additionally, the company produces wine bottles under the "Red Guan Kiln" label. Beyond consumer goods, Hualian China Industry innovates in advanced ceramic materials for electronic components found in mobile phones, watches, and smart wearable devices, alongside dental applications and high-temperature resistant materials, all consolidated under the Hualian Tetao brand. The company also boasts a significant international presence, exporting its diverse product range to roughly 40 countries worldwide through its Hualian International brand.
